channel.title: The AudioSilo blog
channel.description: News, release notes, guides and video tutorials for AudioSilo, the self-hosted audiobook server and player. Every post says when it was last checked against the shipped software.

item.title: Set up AudioSilo with Caddy: Docker Compose and HTTPS
item.description: A step-by-step Caddy reverse proxy guide for AudioSilo, with downloadable Compose files, screenshots, HTTPS settings, phone pairing and troubleshooting.

item.title: Set up AudioSilo with SWAG: Docker Compose and HTTPS
item.description: A step-by-step SWAG reverse proxy guide for AudioSilo, with downloadable Compose files, screenshots, HTTPS settings, phone pairing and troubleshooting.

item.title: Set up AudioSilo with Traefik: Docker Compose and HTTPS
item.description: A step-by-step Traefik reverse proxy guide for AudioSilo, with downloadable Compose files, screenshots, HTTPS settings, phone pairing and troubleshooting.

item.title: Listen to your audiobooks away from home: remote access and HTTPS
item.description: Reach a self-hosted audiobook server from your phone anywhere. The three ways to serve HTTPS, a Caddy or nginx reverse proxy, port forwarding, and home and away addresses.

item.title: How to organise audiobook folders so every player gets them right
item.description: One folder per book, inside its series, inside its author. The layout, naming rules, tags, covers and the awkward cases (disc folders, short stories) that trip scanners up.

item.title: How to back up your Audible library to M4B and listen on your own server
item.description: Download the Audible books you bought as plain M4B files with Libation, OpenAudible or audible-cli, keep them in a folder that scans cleanly, and play them anywhere.

item.title: AudioSilo player tips: 14 features worth knowing
item.description: Undo an accidental jump, let the sleep timer fade out and mark where you dozed off, keep the next books downloaded, set your skip lengths, export your bookmarks and more.

item.title: How to pair your phone with your AudioSilo server using a QR code
item.description: Sign the iPhone, iPad or Android app in to a self-hosted audiobook server by scanning a QR code. Invites, adding more devices, and what to do when it can't connect.

item.title: Fix wrong covers, titles and series in your audiobook library
item.description: Swapped tags, missing covers, a series spelled three ways. How to match books to the community database one at a time or all at once, without touching your files.

item.title: Moving from Audiobookshelf to AudioSilo: what carries over, what doesn't
item.description: An honest comparison of Audiobookshelf and AudioSilo, and the steps to switch without losing anyone's progress, finished books, bookmarks or listening stats.

item.title: AudioSilo Server 2.3: household members, Chromecast and a local metadata copy
item.description: Add kids and grown-ups from the player, see what the house is playing, cast to a Chromecast, keep the community database on your server, and read Audiobookshelf's metadata.json.

item.title: Self-hosted audiobook server: what it is and how to run one with Docker
item.description: A self-hosted audiobook server streams the audiobooks you own to every device and keeps your place in sync. What you need, the options, and a Docker setup in a few steps.

item.title: AudioSilo 2.0: the redesigned player, now in the App Store and on Google Play
item.description: A new player rebuilt around the whole book, on the web, iPhone, iPad and Android. What's in 2.0, from the whole-book timeline and Sleep timer 2.0 to your Year in listening.

item.title: M4B vs MP3 for audiobooks: chapters, size and what plays where
item.description: M4B keeps a whole audiobook in one file with its chapters and cover; MP3 plays on anything. How they differ, when to convert, and how a server handles both.

item.title: Audiobooks on Unraid: an audiobook server from Community Applications
item.description: Install AudioSilo on Unraid from the Apps tab (the LinuxServer.io image), map your audiobooks share read-only, find the first-run password, and set up HTTPS and updates.

item.title: A tour of the AudioSilo admin console
item.description: Four and a half minutes on a real household server - fixing a badly tagged book, the library and series shelves, Health, people and invites, activity and settings.

item.title: AudioSilo Server 2.1 and 2.2: community chapters, books in several series, covers
item.description: Community chapter lists fitted onto your own audio, books that belong to more than one series, community covers in the web player, and a dismissible support card.
